violations.why: ISR can preempt after task writes v_cedar and before it reads it for v_harbor, so the value may be overwritten
ISR can run between the task's initial write and the later read in fn_walnut, breaking atomicity
ISR can preempt between the task's write and the read passed as argument to fn_willow
ISR can preempt before fn_dune reads v_cedar, so the value may have changed
ISR can run after the first read for v_harbor and before the later read in fn_walnut
ISR can intervene between the read for v_harbor and the read used as argument to fn_willow
ISR can preempt after the read for v_harbor and before fn_dune reads v_cedar
ISR can run between the two consecutive reads of v_cedar inside fn_walnut and fn_willow
ISR can intervene between the read in fn_walnut and the later read in fn_dune
ISR can preempt after the argument read for fn_willow and before fn_dune reads v_cedar
